correctness.rationale: Canonical alternating decomposition is valid over every field; the complete signed exterior monomial basis decomposes by single-occupancy choices into Boolean up-operators. Wilson diagonal form supplies exact mod-p ranks; the radical/GL-Sp orbit formula supplies exact multiplicities. The pair-adding block recurrence and 2^r singleton monomials prove strict monotonicity, and characteristic two gives the closed recurrence. Independent modular Gaussian-elimination checks verify all bivectors for n<=5 in several small fields and canonical ranks for p=2,3,5,7 through n=7; general proof is symbolic.

value.rationale: This is a complete operator-rank distribution on all bivectors of every finite exterior algebra, not a sporadic finite census. It proves a surprising complete recovery property (one multiplication-operator rank distinguishes all alternating-form ranks even when wedge powers collapse in small characteristic), and gives characteristic-sensitive exact multiplicities and a simple char-2 law. Such structure has direct motivation in exterior/symplectic algebras and modular Lefschetz rank problems. The formula and proof are explicit and reproducible; novelty and code alone are not the asserted value.
